factProposals.value: Madison AI, Lama and SpryPoint each read a one-way, read-only feed of work orders created or changed, using their own API key and their own versioned data contract.
Lama and SpryPoint receive no titles, descriptions, notes or names, because those can hold personal details; only Madison AI's agreed indexing format includes them.
vendor_exchange_log records every vendor feed request, accepted or refused, with the vendor, caller, contract version, parameters, records returned, outcome, times and request id.

Each vendor integration moves through contract shared, fields confirmed, sandbox tested and signed off, recorded in order by a person with readiness:review; a vendor cannot sign off its own integration.
SCADA is named as a one-way integration in the RFP (REQ-042) but not in REQ-055; it is not built.
Which work order fields Lama and SpryPoint need, and what they do with them, is not known; their contracts are proposed until each vendor confirms.

decisions.statement: Build the vendor integrations as one-way feeds the vendors read.
decisions.rationale: The RFP states these integrations are one-way (REQ-042) and that these systems have no current interface but should be API (REQ-055).

decisions.statement: Check every record against the vendor's contract before sending, and send nothing if any record does not fit.
decisions.rationale: A vendor must never receive data that breaks the agreed contract (the data mismatch failure path).

decisions.statement: Always return the feed cursor, including on the last page.
decisions.rationale: A vendor that polls must be able to save its position and receive only what changed since; returning no cursor on the last page re-sent records.
decisions.evidence: server/vendors.js (vendorFeed); tests/vendorFeedHttp.test.js (picks up only what changed)

decisions.statement: Send no vendor data unless the request is logged and audited in the same transaction.
decisions.rationale: Every vendor interaction must be on record with timestamps and request details.

decisions.statement: Provide a conformance kit with timeouts and capped retries, and never retry a refused key.
decisions.rationale: REQ-054 asks for API testing to be coordinated with each vendor; a shared, repeatable check gives that testing a concrete form.

limitations.statement: No real vendor has connected or run the conformance check; everything is tested against the system itself.
The Lama and SpryPoint contracts are proposals pending each vendor's confirmation.
Only one-way reads are supported; pushing data to a vendor is not built.
